name: CIMIS CLI
tagline: California weather station data at your fingertips
description: A Go command-line tool for querying the California Irrigation Management Information System (CIMIS). Retrieve real-time and historical weather station data for agricultural planning, irrigation scheduling, and climate analysis across California's diverse agricultural regions.
features: Configurable date ranges and data items
